_FACTORS = {'B': 1, 'KB': 1024, 'MB': 1024 * 1024}


def to_bytes(text: str) -> int:
    for unit in ('KB', 'MB', 'B'):
        if text.endswith(unit):
            return int(text[:-len(unit)]) * _FACTORS[unit]
    raise ValueError(f'unknown unit in size: {text!r}')
E
